_comment: Remote (Streamable HTTP) server block. Enable it in StyleNotes under Settings -> MCP -> Remote access, pick an exposure tier (Local for this machine, LAN for your network), then copy the endpoint URL and the access token shown there into this block. Replace http://127.0.0.1:7317/mcp with the LAN address when the client is on another machine. The token is shown once; rotate it in Settings if it leaks. Some stdio-only clients need the `mcp-remote` bridge instead: npx -y mcp-remote http://127.0.0.1:7317/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer <token>".
